title: Detour Credit Caps by Fare, Wayfare Rides
content:
The detour credit cap on a lengthened trip of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** follows the fare charge amount, as booked.

| Fare charge amount | Detour credit cap |
|---|---|
| $50.00 or more (large credit-cap fare) | $8.00 (large detour credit cap) |
| at least $25.00 (mid credit-cap fare), below $50.00 | $4.00 (mid detour credit cap) |
| below $25.00 | not raised by fare size |

A fare charge of at least $50.00 takes the large detour credit cap of $8.00; one of at least $25.00 but below $50.00 takes the mid detour credit cap of $4.00; for a smaller fare charge the detour credit cap is not raised.

## Boundary figures (hypothetical fare charges)

| Fare charge | Cap |
|---|---|
| $24.99 | not raised |
| $25.00 | $4.00 |
| $49.99 | $4.00 |
| $50.00 | $8.00 |
